assets.prompt: Create a 1920x1080 PNG, 16:9. Academic alternatives-analysis map for Module 8. Separate three layers: underlying asset, legal vehicle, and investment strategy. Connect them to investor-level contributions, distributions, residual NAV, fees and carry, leverage, valuation status, liquidity constraints, operational due diligence, and portfolio role. Keep labels short and exact, with a clear cash-flow timeline and no made-up return. Off-white background, navy linework, teal cash-flow arrows, amber vehicle and fee accents, coral liquidity and leverage warnings, and a 7% safe margin. No fund logos or fake performance values.
production_notes: Generated from code so the asset-vehicle-strategy separation and investor cash-flow direction remain exact.
No manager-level data or confidential information appears in the figure.
